baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction 'wa-ma naqamu minhum illa an yu'minu' restricts the grievance to believing, while al-Hamid closes the ayah with praise rather than blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah places a faulting verdict and trusting assent in an exclusive causal frame, then names the object of that assent as worshipped, mighty, and praiseworthy. The alleged defect is therefore the very relation the closing names positively certify: the sentence exposes an inverted indictment rather than supplying a proportionate offense.

activation_trace.role: Faulting and disapproval supply the persecutors' negative verdict and function as the sole charge in the exclusive construction.
Trusting assent supplies the believers' act and makes the supposed offense an inwardly settled affirmation.
Worship and the worshipped one specify that assent as an allegiance rather than a free-floating opinion.
Might and honor counter the attempted abasement and certify the allegiance as attached to invulnerability.
Praise as the opposite of blame supplies the ayah's internal counter-verdict to the persecutors' faulting.

changed_reading.before: The persecutors disliked the believers because they believed in God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an indictment whose only count is praiseworthy trusting allegiance, so the stated motive simultaneously invalidates the persecutors' scale of blame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Naqamu can carry punitive requital, while yu'minu can carry settled security and trust; the object is Allah al-Aziz.
baseline_models.mechanism: On this branch, the verb is not merely an attitude but retaliation enacted against a trust that makes its holders inwardly secure. Their punishment attempts to recover control over allegiance, yet the allegiance terminates in the One characterized by overcoming power, beyond the punishers' jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Punitive requital turns resentment into an enacted coercive response and supplies the mechanism of retaliation.
Settled security and trust identify the inner condition that coercive punishment is trying to break.
The worshipped-one image makes trust a transfer of ultimate allegiance and thus explains the coercers' jurisdictional anxiety.
Overcoming and subduing relocate effective power from those applying punishment to the One in whom trust is placed.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports hostility motivated by religious difference.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses retaliation against an allegiance the persecutors cannot govern: punishment is used to extract submission from a trust secured in a superior power.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grammatical reason clause ends not at 'Allah' but with al-Aziz al-Hamid, placing power and praise inside the explanation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing attributes adjudicate the opening verb. Human faulting is answered first by a power that cannot be subdued and then by praise opposed to blame. The names are therefore functional counter-testimony: the persecutors can impose a penalty, but cannot make their valuation authoritative.

activation_trace.role: Faulting supplies the human verdict whose authority is placed in question.
Rarity and inaccessibility make the divine referent unavailable to seizure or compulsory reassignment.
Finding something praiseworthy or satisfactory functions as a positive finding that overturns the attempted finding of fault.

changed_reading.before: Al-Aziz and al-Hamid are devotional epithets appended to the reason for persecution.
changed_reading.after: The two attributes complete a counter-verdict: coercive blame cannot reach the object of allegiance and cannot convert what is praiseworthy into guilt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointed time and repeated redistribution of witness roles turn the focus's exclusive grievance into an evidentiary charge. The perpetrators are not only seen from outside; they remain present at, and thus become witnesses to, the very act whose only stated ground is faith. The focus clause reads like self-authenticating testimony for a later hearing.

activation_trace.role: Faulting supplies the charge whose evidentiary status is transformed by the surrounding witnesses.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the deferred horizon at which preserved testimony can matter.
Presence with direct seeing supplies the paired witness/witnessed frame and functions as the first evidentiary container.
Presence with seeing makes the actors attending their own deed into involuntary authenticators of it.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies an encompassing witness who can convert observed conduct into an authoritative finding.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from an appointed day and a witness/witnessed pair to perpetrators explicitly watching what they do and God as witness over every thing.
The focus's ma...illa construction isolates a single ground for the hostile verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, repeated witnessing, and the exclusive charge; I infer a juridical arrow from observation to admissible self-incrimination. A live alternative is cosmic attestation without a courtroom mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The exclusivity construction exposes an irrational grievance.
changed_reading.after: The same construction also preserves the persecutors' self-incriminating charge: their presence at the act authenticates that faith alone was treated as guilt for a deferred adjudication.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cut trench, supplied fuel, stationed observation, and witnessed action form a production chain rather than a spontaneous outburst. Read back into naqamu as punitive requital, the focus verse names the selection rule of an engineered coercive apparatus: settled trust is the property the apparatus is built to expose and break.

activation_trace.role: Punitive requital supplies the operative purpose that unifies the surrounding material components.
Settled security and trust supply the human state the apparatus attempts to destabilize.
The long deep cut supplies the apparatus's prepared spatial container.
Fuel as the material of burning supplies the maintained input rather than a momentary flame.
Sitting in watch or ambush supplies stationed supervision and makes violence an administered process.
Presence with seeing supplies monitoring of the process by those carrying it out.

structural_cues: Ayat 4-7 order preparation, combustible input, fixed operators, and observation immediately before the focus states the selection criterion.
The focus plural subjects and objects preserve a social system rather than an isolated interpersonal quarrel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trench, fuel, stationed watching, and witnessed action; I infer a functional chain designed to coerce renunciation. The live alternative is that the sequence only inventories one scene without implying system design.

changed_reading.before: Naqamu describes persecutors reacting violently to belief.
changed_reading.after: Naqamu names the operating rationale of a deliberately provisioned and supervised system whose target variable is the believers' settled trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later metal-assay branch of fitna revises the earlier faulting into an attempted test for defect. Fire is meant to force faith to disclose weakness; paired with settled trust and the cohesion branch of al-Aziz, the same ordeal can instead disclose what holds together. Persecution becomes an assay whose result contradicts its operators' accusation.

activation_trace.role: Fault-finding supplies the operators' hypothesis that belief contains a defect.
Settled trust supplies the tested state whose persistence can count as a result.
Hard ground and cohesion provide the material analogy for faith remaining integrated under pressure.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism and converts suffering into a test with a discoverable result.
Burning and its blackening supply the assay's heat and keep the mechanism visibly tied to the scene's violence.

structural_cues: The same surah places burning before the focus and names the persecuting action with a root that can image testing by fire after it.
Al-Aziz is grammatically inside the focus's statement of what the believers affirm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faulting, fiery testing, settled trust, and cohesion; I supply the reversal that an ordeal intended to prove defect instead demonstrates integrity. The live alternative is fitna as torment alone, with no revelatory result.

changed_reading.before: The persecutors punish what they have already judged defective.
changed_reading.after: Their punishment also operates as an unintended assay: the attempt to expose faith as a flaw discloses the cohesion of trust attached to al-Aziz.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus baseline reads punishment as a bid to govern allegiance. The following ownership and witness claims strip that bid of ultimate jurisdiction: those who punish can control bodies locally, but the worshipped object owns the whole field and knows the case. Their requital becomes a counterfeit exercise of sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Punitive requital supplies the coercers' practical claim to judge and enforce allegiance.
The worshipped-one image supplies the allegiance over which competing authority is asserted.
Overcoming power supplies the capacity that makes the divine claim effective rather than honorary.
Kingship and dominion supply the encompassing jurisdiction that relativizes the persecutors' local command.
Knowledge-bearing declaration supplies competent oversight of every act within that dominion.

structural_cues: The relative clause immediately after the focus assigns the heavens and earth to the same Allah named as the object of belief.
The focus punishing subject is plural and bounded, whereas the following ownership and witness claims are comprehensive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, punitive action, total dominion, and informed witness; I infer a jurisdictional conflict in which persecution performs counterfeit sovereignty. The live alternative is that dominion merely consoles without diagnosing the coercers' political claim.

changed_reading.before: The persecutors retaliate because believers transfer allegiance away from them.
changed_reading.after: Their retaliation is an unauthorized jurisdictional performance inside the dominion of the very One whose allegiance they try to prohibit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's punitive-requital branch is reassigned: those who punish faith encounter punishment and burning, so vengeance does not remain in their hands. Yet return, protective covering of fault, and love prevent a merely symmetrical revenge model. The focus becomes a diagnosis of usurped requital inside a moral order that can both reverse force and reopen relation.

activation_trace.role: Punitive requital supplies the humanly seized function that the context subsequently reassigns.
Painful punishment supplies the reversed consequence for those who made belief punishable.
Flame supplies a material return of the medium the persecutors had administered.
Return after departure supplies reversal and recurrence without requiring the cycle to remain in human control.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer supplies a possible exit from strict retaliatory symmetry.
Love and affection supply restored relation as a live endpoint alongside reversal.

structural_cues: Ayah 10 conditions punishment on persecuting and then not turning back, leaving the negated return structurally significant.
The punishment sequence is followed by beginning, return, forgiveness, and love rather than ending at mirrored fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human requital, reversed punishment, return, protective forgiveness, and love; I infer that legitimate requital both displaces the persecutors' authority and preserves an avenue of return. A live alternative reads the later attributes as general praise unrelated to the persecutors' possible change.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts innocent believers with persecutors who will simply receive equivalent punishment.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes human vengeance as a seized prerogative: its force is reversed, but the surrounding order remains open to return, protection from fault's effects, and restored relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith's security branch initially appears paradoxical because believing triggers exposure to fire. The garden's screened enclosure, ongoing flow, and rescue resolve that paradox spatially and temporally: the trust does not guarantee immediate insulation from coercion, but orients its holders toward a protected, provisioned ecology beyond the persecutors' apparatus.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the apparently contradicted promise that the context redistributes across time and space.
A garden screened by vegetation supplies a habitable enclosure opposed to the exposed enclosure of the trench.
A protective shield supplies active shelter rather than mere concealment.
Continuing provision supplies a maintained counter-system to maintained fuel.
Attaining good and escaping harm supply the completed movement from threatened security to realized safety.

structural_cues: Believers recur as the grammatical subject immediately after the persecutors' threatened outcome.
The paired scenes contrast a fueled trench watched from above with gardens and waters flowing from below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies security, screened protection, continuing provision, and rescue; I infer that the garden scene realizes over time the security semantically active in faith. The live alternative is reward after suffering without a lexical answer to the security paradox.

changed_reading.before: Belief is inward security even though it provokes immediate external danger.
changed_reading.after: Belief carries a deferred spatial claim: the coercers can move believers into a consuming enclosure, but cannot cancel their orientation toward a shielding and continuously provisioned enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The apparent geometry of the focus has persecutors acting upon a bounded 'them.' Covering truth, placing something behind appearance, and divine encompassing reverse that geometry: the believers may look enclosed by hostile power, but the hostile group is itself enclosed by the God it tries to hide. Al-Aziz's inaccessibility prevents the outer enclosure from being captured by the inner one.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the believers' relation to an outer protection not visible from their immediate confinement.
Inaccessibility supplies the reason the enclosing divine relation cannot itself be seized by the persecutors.
Veiling truth supplies the perceptual layer that makes the persecutors mistake their inner enclosure for total control.
Placing something behind what appears supplies the hidden outer position from which the visible power relation is reversed.
Physical encirclement supplies the nested geometry: the apparent encirclers are themselves inside another boundary.
Encompassing domination and destruction supply the possibility that the outer boundary can decisively overcome the inner captors.

structural_cues: The focus's minhum marks a persecutor/believer relation that the later min wara'ihim turns around the persecutors themselves.
Allah occurs inside the focus as the object of trust and later as the subject positioned beyond and around the deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, behindness, encompassing, and divine inaccessibility; I infer nested enclosures in which visible captors are contained. A live alternative takes 'behind' and 'encompassing' as knowledge or pursuit without a spatial reversal.

changed_reading.before: A powerful group encloses and punishes a vulnerable believing group.
changed_reading.after: The visible enclosure is only the inner one: those who confine believers are themselves surrounded by the inaccessible object of the believers' trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opposes persecuting blame to divine praise. The closing sequence adds a media mechanism: covering truth and assigning falsehood are answered by gathering/reciting, magnifying through mention, inscription, and guarding. The persecutors' charge is not only overturned; the attempt to suppress it becomes durable public evidence of the faith they targeted.

activation_trace.role: Faulting supplies the hostile evaluation that the archive preserves for reversal rather than allowing it to define the victims.
Praise opposed to blame supplies the counter-evaluation that the record carries forward.
Veiling truth supplies the attempted suppression to which the later record responds.
Assigning a thing or speaker to falsehood supplies an adversarial label that requires durable counter-testimony.
Gathering and assembly supply the collection of dispersed events into a transmissible whole.
Reading and recitation supply repeated public reactivation of what suppression sought to silence.
Magnifying by recounting glory supplies the evaluative amplification that reverses the persecutors' blame.
A broad writing surface supplies the durable material support of the counter-record.
Guarding and attentive preservation supply resistance to erasure or alteration.

structural_cues: The final contrast moves from deniers being inside takdhib to a gathered recitation characterized by majid and located in a guarded writing support.
The focus itself preserves the persecutors' stated reason while grammatically attaching praise to the object of the prohibited faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, falsification, collection, recitation, magnification, writing, and guarding; I infer a counter-archive that converts attempted suppression into enduring testimony. A live alternative treats the closing scripture description as authority for the surah without a media-level reversal of the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The ayah verbally reverses the persecutors' blame by naming God praiseworthy.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is also part of the reversal's machinery: the silenced allegiance and its hostile charge are gathered, recited, magnified, written, and guarded against the deniers' attempted erasure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a divine attribute and the trench through a shared material geometry rather than as direct lexical paraphrase. It remains anchored in al-Aziz's hard-ground/cohesion branch and the focus's persecuted allegiance, with the packet's deep-cut branch supplying the opposing operation. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy: the trench can scar ground and bodies without demonstrating that allegiance itself has fragmented.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-Aziz at focus word 8 can activate hard, cohesive ground as the quality of the One in whom the believers trust.

activation_trace.role: Hard ground and material cohesion supply the resistant substrate to which the focus allegiance is attached.
A long deep incision supplies the hostile attempt to divide, contain, and make a visible rupture.
Added fuel supplies sustained pressure within the incision rather than a single cutting event.

changed_reading.before: The trench is the place where believers are physically destroyed for allegiance to al-Aziz.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the scene opposes incision to cohesion: persecutors can cut and fuel a trench in the visible ground, but the focus attaches trust to a hard-to-fragment ground of power.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the amen/request image should not be substituted as the morphological gloss of yu'minu. It remains packet-licensed as an associative branch of the exact focus root, anchored to believing in Allah and activated by an appointed promise and return. Downstream prose should mark it as resonance only: persecuted faith sounds like a request for response whose answer is deferred, not absent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yu'minu at focus word 6 and the immediately governed divine name permit an exploratory activation of the root's response-seeking amen branch.

activation_trace.role: Saying amen as a request for response supplies an invocation-like resonance within the believers' focus action.
The fixed divine name in invocation formulas supplies the addressee toward whom the response-seeking resonance points.
A promise fixed to an appointment supplies delay with a determined horizon rather than nonresponse.
Return after departure supplies eventual response and reversal after the apparent silence of persecution.

changed_reading.before: The believers are punished for assent to God while no answer is visible in the focus scene.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, their believing also sounds like an appeal of 'respond/let it be,' with the promised appointment converting apparent silence into deferred answer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is deliberately cross-domain: the difficult-milking branch of al-Aziz is not a lexical gloss for the divine title. It remains anchored in that exact focus title and in punitive action against belief, while seizure and assay branches make coercive extraction a coherent mechanism. Downstream prose should call it an agrarian-mechanical analogy for refusal under pressure, not an attribute definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins punitive requital against believing to al-Aziz, whose inventory includes an image of a tightly held yield that is difficult to extract.

activation_trace.role: Punitive requital supplies pressure applied in order to obtain changed allegiance.
Tightness and difficult milking supply the image of a desired yield that force cannot readily extract.
Testing a person or metal supplies the coercive procedure intended to force disclosure of what is inside.
Seizing with force supplies the extraction pressure and makes the analogy mechanically coherent.

changed_reading.before: Violence punishes believers after their allegiance is known.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, violence is also failed extraction: force tests and seizes bodies to obtain renunciation, but trust in al-Aziz is figured as a yield that coercion cannot draw out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This ecological reading is surprising because it activates a seed-covering branch of kufr rather than treating the later denial only propositionally. It remains anchored in the focus's believing and is supported by the garden branch elsewhere in the packet. Downstream prose should qualify the causal arrow: attempted covering resembles burial that may enable later growth; the packet does not explicitly say persecution causes the garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes believing the exact object of hostile suppression, allowing later covering imagery to act on that same allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Settled trust supplies the living content the persecutors try to suppress.
Covering seed supplies the ecological transformation of suppression into burial with latent emergence.
A garden screened by dense growth supplies the later state in which what was covered is no longer erased but proliferating.
Continuous provision supplies the sustaining condition for emergence after burial.

changed_reading.before: Deniers try to cover and extinguish the faith for which believers are punished.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their covering behaves like covering seed: attempted erasure places living trust into a hidden phase answered by protected growth and continuing provision.

strongest_changes: The exclusive grievance becomes preserved evidence: perpetrators witnessing their own act authenticate that faith alone was criminalized.
Trench, fuel, fixed watchers, and testimony turn punitive requital into an engineered apparatus aimed at breaking settled trust.
The apparent captors become the inner party in a nested enclosure when hidden divine encompassing is read back into the focus.
Covering and falsification are answered by gathering, recitation, magnification, inscription, and guarding, so the focus functions as a counter-archive.
Fitna's assay image permits a live reversal in which punishment intended to prove defect instead reveals cohesion.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah already contains two opposed evaluations (fault and praise) and two opposed powers (human requital and divine inaccessibility). Context did not settle one meaning; it distributed these tensions across witness procedure, material apparatus, sovereignty, assay, reversible requital, protective ecology, nested space, and preserved media.
remaining_uncertainties: The juridical reading depends on inferring an arrow from repeated witnessing to adjudication rather than generic attestation.
Encompassing can support knowledge, protection, or destructive domination; the nested-enclosure model intentionally keeps more than one valence live.
The amen, difficult-milking, trench/cohesion, and buried-seed readings are branch-mediated analogies and must not be rendered as direct lexical glosses.
The opening toward return, forgiveness, and love may address the persecutors specifically or may function as a broader divine characterization.
